title: cotyledon pulvinata
intro: Cotyledon pulvinata, commonly known as Pig's Ear or Bear's Ear, is a succulent plant species native to South Africa. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving anxiety and stress, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Cotyledon pulvinata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins. Additionally, its extracts have been studied for their potential to inhibit cancer cell growth and exhibit neuroprotective effects.
